one_line: A doctor should be able to hand a case over to another clinic, which takes it on with everything already on it.
questions: If the receiving clinic never accepts a handover, what should happen to it and to the case it was started from?
acceptance_criteria: A doctor who is a member of the clinic holding a case can start a handover from it, naming a receiving clinic and a note.
A doctor who is a member of the receiving clinic can accept a waiting handover, and the case then belongs to that clinic.
After acceptance the sending clinic's doctors can read the case and cannot change it.
The patient sees one line in the message thread naming the clinic that now holds the case.
A doctor who is a member of neither clinic sees no handover control anywhere.
not_verified: I could not read any of the product's code in this run, so I have not checked what a clinic overview shows today.
notes: Everything the ticket sets out to decide, it decides. What it never touches is the handover that is waiting and stays waiting.
